decisions.reason: A passenger check-in mobile app is adjacent to the firm’s airport business but relatively far from its core security and operational know-how, so under an absorptive-capacity view the firm is less likely to learn and improve it efficiently than to redeploy resources elsewhere.

Passenger processing technology fits closely with the firm’s existing airport-security capabilities, integrated solutions model, and in-house technology base, giving it strong ability to interpret early market feedback and refine the product line.

A self-service airline check-in solution serves existing customers but is more peripheral to the firm’s core security competence than screening and processing technologies, making continued investment less attractive if results are still uncertain.
